definitions.explanation: The practice of reading books or stories aloud to children, an important educational and bonding activity.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To read aloud to a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧、⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Every night, I read a picture book aloud before bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毎週土曜日|まいしゅうどようび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{子|こ}ども{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The library holds a read-aloud event for children every Saturday.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound noun from ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + ⟦{聞|き}かせる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to let someone hear / to tell). Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

Widely promoted in Japanese education as beneficial for children's language development and parent-child bonding. Libraries, bookstores, and schools regularly hold {読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do a read-aloud
- ⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ: picture book read-aloud
- {読|よ}み{聞|き}かせ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧: read-aloud volunteer
